query: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (a)-[reference:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(sb:Spec) WHERE sa.specNumber <> sb.specNumber RETURN DISTINCT sa.specNumber AS fromSpec, sb.specNumber AS toSpec, count(DISTINCT reference) AS referenceEdgeCount ORDER BY referenceEdgeCount DESC, fromSpec ASC, toSpec ASC LIMIT 10
